notes.title: Celebrating the speedrunners
notes.content:
To my surprise someone actually managed to complete the game...
Even multiple times!

As a result of this, some bugs related to the final screen came up, and are now fixed.

Also, to show my appreciation to the people brave enough to try and speedrun the game, a special spot in the main menu has been reserved to the player who currently holds the world record!

[b]Thank you so much for playing Chicken Cannon![/b]

[i]Matteo Dalmasso[/i]
